name: seated pike fold
description: Sitting with both legs straight together, you fold forward from the hips. It is the basic hamstring stretch for the pike and the toe touch.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and together in front of you.
Pull your toes toward you and press the backs of your knees down.
Sit tall, then hinge forward from your hips.
Reach for your shins, ankles or feet without forcing.
Hold and breathe, letting yourself sink a little on each exhale.
